hooks_fired.name: mvs_app_config
hooks_fired.note: Extension point Pro fills with the `documents` block, so a client never hardcodes the format list, size ceiling or preview tiers. P4.4.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_can_grant
hooks_fired.note: D1 seam for non-personal drives. DEFAULTS FALSE so an unanswered filter denies rather than opening sharing to every member of a space.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_folder_created
hooks_fired.note: Fires after a document folder is created.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_folder_privacy_cascaded
hooks_fired.note: T2. Fires after a tightening has swept the subtree. Loosening never cascades, so it does not fire.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_folder_trashed
hooks_fired.note: Fires after a folder and its subtree are trashed.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_max_depth
hooks_fired.note: Folder nesting cap, default 12. Raising past 16 pushes `path` beyond KEY subtree's 150-byte prefix, so deep trees silently stop using the index.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_owns_drive
hooks_fired.note: Space-drive ownership seam, resolved once per drive per request. Defaults false.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_document_uploaded
hooks_fired.note: Fires after a document is ingested. Quota rides the existing mvs_media_uploaded instead, which is why D2 needs no fourth counter.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_media_feed_allows_documents
hooks_fired.note: Production Rule 3 escape hatch for P1.5. GET /media?media_type=document (and /me/media, which delegates to the same handler) returned document rows until 2.4.0 and the parameter has advertised 'document' in its enum since the first release. The route now answers 400 mvs_document_route; this filter restores the old behaviour for at least two majors. Default false.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_media_library_types
hooks_fired.note: Production Rule 3 escape hatch for narrowing MEDIA_LIBRARY to media only (owner, 2026-08-09: documents never render in a media grid). Restoring legacy_document re-accepts the broken tile.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_media_single_actions
consumed_by: wpmediaverse-pro (Frontend\BoostAffordance — boost store/modal + owner button on the canonical single-media page, all layouts)

hooks_fired.name: mvs_media_type_for_mime
hooks_fired.note: Production Rule 3 escape hatch for P2.1. get_media_type() used to return 'document' for any unrecognised MIME; it now returns ''. A filter value outside MediaTypes::ALL is ignored, so an unknown string cannot defeat the positive type predicates downstream. Added to the manifest 2026-08-09 -- it shipped in the P2.1 commit without a manifest delta.

hooks_fired.name: mvs_rest_require_auth
consumed_by: buddynext (arms it when buddynext_private_community is on)
